gr_list.description: Google Yorum + Referans Motoru: Review request gonderme, referral code uretme, tracking
Medikal Turizm Lead Capture: Yabanci hasta akisi, doviz bazli fiyat, EN dil destegi

plan.summary: Yeni Invekto.Marketing mikroservisi (port 7112) olustur: GR-3.21 Google Yorum + Referans Motoru (review_requests, referrals tablolari, review link gonderme, referral code uretme) ve GR-3.22 Medikal Turizm Lead Capture (medical_tourism_leads tablosu, yabanci hasta akisi, EN dil destegi). Backend proxy + mevcut pattern.
plan.q_intent: PKT-6C2 interview sonucu: Split 6C2+6C3, yeni Marketing servisi (7112), sadece EN dil, ChatAnalysis/AgentAI degisikligi yok.
plan.interview_notes: 1) Scope split: PKT-6C2 (GR-3.21+3.22) + PKT-6C3 (GR-3.24+3.25). 2) Cross-service: sadece Appointments+Backend. 3) Service: yeni Invekto.Marketing (7112). 4) Languages: EN only. 5) GR-3.22 de Marketing servisinde.

verification_questions.question: Do all repository queries include tenant_id in WHERE clauses for multi-tenant isolation?
verification_questions.codex_answer: All SELECT/UPDATE queries include tenant_id filters

verification_questions.question: Are all SQL queries using const string with parameterized queries (no string concatenation)?
verification_questions.codex_answer: Repository SQL is declared as const strings and uses NpgsqlCommand parameters only

verification_questions.question: Does the Marketing service JWT auth middleware protect all /api/v1/ endpoints and reject unauthenticated requests?
verification_questions.codex_answer: app.UseJwtAuth applied before endpoints, each endpoint validates TenantContext

verification_questions.question: Do all endpoints catch NpgsqlException and return proper error codes (INV-MK-xxx or INV-DB-001)?
verification_questions.codex_answer: Each Marketing endpoint wraps repository calls with NpgsqlException catch and returns INV-DB-001 or INV-MK codes

verification_questions.question: Are referral codes generated with sufficient entropy to prevent guessing (e.g., GUID-based or crypto-random)?
verification_questions.codex_answer: Referral codes use RandomNumberGenerator.Fill with 8 random bytes and 32-char alphanumeric alphabet

non_goals: Risk engine veya sentiment analizi (PKT-6C3 scope)
Language router veya multi-lang pipeline (PKT-6C3 scope)
Google Maps API entegrasyonu (sadece link gonderme)

try_catch_locations: Marketing/Program.cs: her endpoint NpgsqlException + FormatException catch
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All DB calls wrapped in try-catch with typed catches. All proxy calls have timeout + error handling.

aha_moments.user_pain: Klinik tedavi sonrasi hasta memnun ama yorum yazmayi unutuyor, Google puani dusuk kaliyor
aha_moments.suggestion: Otomatik review request: tedavi basarili + hasta memnun -> Google Maps link ile yorum rica mesaji
aha_moments.aha_moment: Klinik sahibi dashboard'da 'Bu ay 15 yeni Google yorumu aldik' goruyor — once ayda 2 yorumlari vardi

aha_moments.user_pain: Klinik referral takibi yok, hangi hasta kimi getirdi bilinmiyor, indirim kontrolsuz veriliyor
aha_moments.suggestion: Referral code sistemi: her memnun hastaya unique kod, arkadasi kodu kullaninca her ikisine indirim, tracking otomatik
aha_moments.aha_moment: Klinik sahibi 'REF-A7X2 kodu ile 8 yeni hasta geldi, toplam 40K TL gelir' raporunu goruyor

aha_moments.user_pain: Yabanci hasta gece 2'de yaziyor, sabah 9'a kadar cevap yok, hasta rakibe gitmis
aha_moments.suggestion: Medical tourism lead otomatik yakalama: patient_country + lang + treatment_interest aninda kayit
aha_moments.aha_moment: Klinik sabah acildiginda 'Gece 3 yeni uluslararasi lead geldi, hepsi kayitli' goruyor — once kayboluyorlardi

aha_moments.user_pain: Referral kodlari elle takip ediliyor, Excel'de kayboluyor, duplike indirim veriliyor
aha_moments.suggestion: Crypto-random referral code + unique constraint + status tracking (active/redeemed/expired)
aha_moments.aha_moment: Klinik 'Bu kod zaten kullanilmis' uyarisi aliyor — once ayni kodu 3 kez farkli kisiye veriyorlardi

aha_moments.user_pain: Medikal turizm leadleri farkli kanallarda dagilmis, takip edilen/edilmeyen belli degil
aha_moments.suggestion: Tek pipeline: lead -> contacted -> consultation -> booked -> treated -> reviewed, status tracking ile
aha_moments.aha_moment: Klinik koordinatoru 'Bu hafta 12 lead var, 5 consulted, 2 booked' goruyor — once sayilari tahmin ediyorlardi
